fix_commit_message:
[truetype] Tighten code overflow checks.

Fixes #1336.

* src/truetype/ttinterp.c (Ins_NPUSHB,NPUSHW,PUSHB, PUSHW):
Tighten conditions.
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix 828916527ce4 on top of intro c3a5513508d7 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (OutOfBoundsRead): A heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) exists in the TrueType interpreter's push-byte instruction handler (`Ins_NPUSHB`) and three related functions (`Ins_NPUSHW`, `Ins_PUSHB`, `Ins_PUSHW`). An off-by-one error in newly introduced code-overflow guards allows a maliciously crafted TrueType font to cause the interpreter to read one or more bytes past the end of the heap-allocated instruction stream buffer. Root cause: The introducing commit `c3a5513` refactored the PUSH instruction handlers to perform their own IP advance and bounds checking. The bounds check `IP + L > exc->codeSize` uses strict greater-than, but the code array is 0-indexed (size `codeSize`, indices 0..codeSize-1). When `IP + L` exactly equals `codeSize`, the check passes, and the subsequent byte-reading loop reaches `exc->code[codeSize]` — one byte past the allocation.
